name: More Chat Messages
author: SCUMSA
description: Announce what happens on your server in the game's own chat. Kills, players joining and leaving, cargo drops, bunkers opening and closing, and bases being raided - each one switched on separately, sent to the chat channel you choose, and worded however you like. Everything ships off, so nothing is announced until you say so.

needs.why: Cargo drops are in no log the manager reads and in no table of SCUM.db - the only place they exist is the running game, and this module is what reports them. Without these two switches the cargo announcement has nothing to watch and stays silent; every other announcement here reads the server's own log and is unaffected.
